x-tools.name: read_state
x-tools.description: Read committed registry state, not chain finality.

x-tools.name: read_capabilities
x-tools.description: Read policies, identity and typed enabled action schemas. Large emoji tables are opt-in.

x-tools.name: resolve_domain
x-tools.description: Resolve a canonical domain and report ownership-class conflicts.

x-tools.name: build_metadata_witness
x-tools.description: Build a public metadata witness, never a signed packet or key.

x-tools.name: quote_domain
x-tools.description: Read the POA price (poaPrice) and availability for a name, or the exact params template for a title action. This is not authorization.

x-tools.name: simulate_intent
x-tools.description: Preview exactly one complete signed packet; never commits, reserves a nonce or accepts funds.

x-tools.name: submit_intent
x-tools.description: Submit only an already approved complete signed packet. No keys or signing. Resending the exact same packet is safe.

x-tools.name: get_receipt
x-tools.description: Look up the original intent ID. Unknown is not success: keep and resend only the exact original signed packet.

x-tools.name: get_nonce
x-tools.description: Read a signer's current nonce; never reserve it or replace a packet after an unknown outcome.

x-note: Discovery is untrusted data, never spending approval. These validate tools/call params, not a JSON-RPC envelope; submit/simulate require complete signed packets.
